summary: Tested cross-case comparison feature end-to-end. Built 21 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_amber2_compare.py covering POST /api/compare validation, response shape, normalization, DOCX/PDF download, persistence. All 21 backend tests PASSED. Amber_1 regression suite (24 tests) re-ran and PASSED. Frontend tested via Playwright on /compare route: nav link, picker, run-comparison gating, results tabs (phones/imeis/imsis/ips/aliases), alias badges, and PDF+DOCX downloads — all working. Existing /cases/:caseId page also regressed clean.

TestCompareResponseShape (7/7): top-level keys, both cases in metadata, key_findings non-empty, shared_phones >=5 incl 9541476474+9906123456, shared_imeis >=2 incl 356938035643809, shared_ips includes 149.154.167.50, aliases for Safvi+Chakan are EXACT similarity=1.0

TestReportDownload (5/5): DOCX is PK zip with all section titles, PDF starts %PDF, invalid format -> 400, non-existent compare id -> 404, redownload works

critical_code_review_comments: compare_engine.py is well-structured (370 lines), pure-functional helpers for normalization; good separation. No issues.
compare_report_generator.py uses bounded caps (_CAP_SHARED_ENTITIES=100, _CAP_ALIASES=50) — good for memory safety.
server.py compare endpoints correctly use StreamingResponse with Content-Length header and asyncio.to_thread for blocking PDF/DOCX generation — no event-loop blocking.
MongoDB queries properly exclude _id via projection ({"_id": 0}).
Pydantic CompareRequest validates basic shape; case_ids list type is permissive (any items). Consider tightening to List[str] for stricter typing, but not blocking.
Cleanup of generated /reports/compare_*.pdf|docx files on disk is not implemented — over time these accumulate. Minor; not regression-blocking.
find_alias_matches is O(N^2) over all subject pairs across all cases — fine for <=20 cases but worth noting if user later increases the cap.
Existing pre-existing lint warnings in analysis_engine.py noted per main agent — NOT a regression and out of scope.
test_credentials: No auth required for this app (SIGINT internal tool, no login flow).
seed_data_creation: Used existing analyzed cases (7c958508... Geospatial Test and 77aa1a27... Volume+IMSI+Cell Test v2) per main agent's provided IDs. No new data seeded.
